def solve_m_backtrack(m):
    edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(m), 2))
    num_edges = len(edges)
    triangles = list(itertools.combinations(range(m), 3))
    target_triples = set(tuple(sorted(triple)) for triple in itertools.combinations(range(m), 3))
    
    tri_edge_indices = []
    for tri in triangles:
        e1 = tuple(sorted((tri[0], tri[1])))
        e2 = tuple(sorted((tri[1], tri[2])))
        e3 = tuple(sorted((tri[0], tri[2])))
        idx1 = edges.index(e1)
        idx2 = edges.index(e2)
        idx3 = edges.index(e3)
        tri_edge_indices.append((idx1, idx2, idx3))

    n_c = (m-1)//2
    edge_to_color = [-1] * num_edges
    color_counts = [0] * m

    def backtrack(edge_idx):
        if edge_idx == num_edges:
            found_triples = set()
            for idx1, idx2, idx3 in tri_edge_indices:
                c1, c2, c3 = edge_to_color[idx1], edge_to_color[idx2], edge_to_color[idx3]
                if c1 != c2 and c2 != c3 and c1 != c3:
                    found_triples.add(tuple(sorted((c1, c2, c3))))
            return found_triples == target_triples

                color_counts[c] -= 1
